name: Impeccable（前端设计工具集）
examples_zh: 审查 SaaS 仪表盘的视觉层级
让落地页更适合海外自助注册用户
为移动端页面补充响应式布局和微交互
检查页面的可访问性、性能和设计一致性
examples_en: Review the visual hierarchy of this SaaS dashboard
Make this landing page better for global self-serve signup users
Add responsive layout and micro-interactions to the mobile page
Check this page for accessibility, performance, and design consistency
description_zh: 高品质 UI/UX 设计工具集：帮助生成独特、生产级的前端界面，涵盖视觉风格、布局排版、动效交互、质量保障、设计系统等全方位设计能力，避免泛 AI 审美
description_en: UI/UX design quality toolkit for creating distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design standards across visual style, layout, motion, quality assurance, and design systems
